title: Configuring the Claroty xDome for Healthcare Connector

blocks.text: Claroty xDome for Healthcare (formerly Medigate) is a modular, SaaS-powered industrial cybersecurity platform that provides real-time visibility, vulnerability management, and threat detection to protect healthcare organizations' medical devices, networks, and systems from cyber threats.
There are two Claroty xDome for Healthcare streams. Select those that are based on your Claroty xDome for Healthcare feature plan and use cases:

blocks.item: Claroty xDome Healthcare - Assets: Retrieves device information, including network and device details, vulnerabilities, and risk scores, as well as visibility and security posture data such as last seen and scan times, end-of-life status, and authentication user lists.

Claroty xDome Healthcare - Vulnerabilities: Retrieves vulnerability data including severity scores, affected products and devices, exploitability data, and recommendations for remediation, as well as vulnerability status and assignment details.

blocks.text: The Claroty xDome for Healthcare connector is in limited availability. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.

The Claroty xDome for Healthcare source authentication configuration requires an API token. To retrieve a token for the Claroty xDome connector, you must first create an API user and then generate a token for that user. Creating an API user requires admin privileges. The API user must carry at least read permissions for the sites that you want the API to access.

blocks.item: Log in to the Claroty portal as an admin.
In the top navigation bar, click Settings, then select System Settings.
In the left-side navigation, click User Management.
A list of the users in the account appears.
User Info: Enter a username and title.
Permissions: Make sure to assign at least read permissions for the sites that you want the API to access.

blocks.text: You are redirected to the User Management page, where you can generate a token for the user you created.

blocks.item: Hover over the Status column, and click Generate Token.
The Generate API token window appears, displaying the API token.
Save the token securely as you cannot copy or view it later.

blocks.text: To create the Claroty xDome for Healthcare data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the Claroty xDome for Healthcare data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
In the Claroty Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.

From the drop-down menu, select the region of your Claroty xDome instance. This is determined by the geographic region where your Claroty xDome platform is hosted (e.g., US, Europe, Canada, or Australia).

blocks.text: For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
